description: This file defines the LessThanOperator class, which implements a comparison operator for filtering, specifically representing the 'less than' filter in the JSON API v1 filter operators. It includes methods to return the filter tag, SQL operator, and validate input operators.

classes.name: LessThanOperator
classes.description: Represents a 'less than' comparison filter operator within the JSON API filter system.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter tag 'lt' used to indicate 'less than' in filter expressions.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL representation of the 'less than' operator, i.e., '<'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and adheres to the expected criteria for the 'less than' operator.
